DefeatFieldRevealBookkeeping: Field-reveal bookkeeping: skip when deathActionIdx is 0 or its $0100-base event flag is already set; otherwise set it and spawn SpawnFieldRevealEffect with the index.
DefeatFieldRevealReturn: Return to the caller of the CallNear subroutine.
EnemyDefeatDispatch: Entry (X = defeated actor). Last enemy ($0AEC = 1): halt and JumpFar to StandardEnemyDefeatHandler. Otherwise run EnemyDefeatDispatch_CountKill, spawn field_reveal_object with the remaining count in $26, and Die.
EnemyDefeatDispatch_CountKill: Per-enemy death processing (CallNear): sound #03, BCD and hex counter decrements, halt, death flash, kill flag, collision clear, optional field-reveal effect; returns with RestoreSavedPtr.
EnemyDefeatDispatch_NotLast: Not the last enemy: per-enemy death processing, then the gem pickup child (field_reveal_object), then Die.
mu_color_window_setup: Colour-window set-up of the Mu vampire lair, spawned by mu67_male_vampire at its start (address 717306) and run once: WOBJSEL = $30 (colour window 1 enabled and inverted), CGWSEL = $22 (colour math prevented inside the window area, the sub screen is the addend) and CGADSUB = $03 (add to BG1 and BG2). The window itself is the circle that circle_window_thinker_v2 builds from the parameters at $F6 / $FA / $FE: with the radius $FFFF the window is empty and no colour math runs; with a circle the fixed colour is added to BG1 and BG2 only inside it (measured with the parameters forced to centre ($80, $70) and radius $30: a 97 x 97 pixel round patch tinted by the fixed colour, nothing changed outside it).
